name: dooles-tools
description: doolecg's Claude Code mods: Sidebar, Flightdeck, Bottom Bar, Task View, Self Improve, Prompt Enhancer, Idea Shelf, Context and Rule Guard. The skills are in doolecg/Dooles_Skills.

plugins.name: bottom-bar
plugins.description: A compact rounded bar at the bottom of the terminal (model, effort, context, 5-hour and 7-day usage, agents) with a Doole's Tools pill that holds the mods you pick and opens a toolbox.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: A calm, plain-English checklist above the prompt while Claude works, with the tool calls, diffs and command output hidden.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: A Flightdeck-style sidebar: the main session's vitals and every subagent working now, each as an outlined pixel progress bar with a stop button, in the Bottom Bar's colours.

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: One sidebar with a tab for each of your mods (Flightdeck, Self Improve, Clean View, Idea Shelf and the rest), in the Bottom Bar's colours.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: An Enhance Prompt button in the Bottom Bar (or its own row) that rewrites the prompt in the box using Hindsight, CodeGraph, the session, your soul.md and your skills, with recall counts and Undo.

plugins.name: self-improve
plugins.description: Learns from finished sessions: lessons to Hindsight or markdown, a soul.md profile kept in step with a Soul Bank, skill drafts and fixes you approve, a skill scorecard and rollback.

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Park ideas with /idea while Claude works, one shelf per project, and send them later from /ideas.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Context: publishes the facts for the Sidebar footer (Hindsight, CodeGraph, git, test and fix passes) and counts test and fix passes against a limit.

plugins.name: rule-guard
plugins.description: Stops tool calls that break your rules (AI credit in commits, v tags, pushing or releasing unasked, killing by name, skipping hooks, testing past the pass limit) and tells Claude why. Its rules are switches on its Sidebar tab.
